snippet.title: ROB RUN: Closed Alpha Gameplay
snippet.description:
We held a playtest of ROB RUN with selected players: the task was to rob, race, shoot, and, of course, break as much as possible.
The team has already received feedback, and the improvements are in the works.

Check out the newest gameplay footage: heists, police pursuits, shootouts, cars, and leveling up.
This is what ROB RUN looks like right now!
